scope: One independently audited Qwen3-4B paired full cycle and an unrelated general7B access probe; neither means twenty completed models
return_definition: 100 * (ending capital / initial capital - 1); cumulative, after modeled trading costs
audit: Slurm step2124996, original candidate4 immutable source; independent recomputation must match original saved accounting receipt

access_probe.scope: Unscored explicit reader check, not spontaneous investment behavior or a full return result. This is general7B, distinct from Coder7B.

limits: Retrospective development data, not unseen holdout
Historical source vintages assumed, not independently verified
One paired repeat is not a model-level three-repeat conclusion
Tool execution does not prove understanding or causal benefit of an individual library feature
Earlier source versions and both positive and negative results remain published
Full public decision/NAV/trade ledger excludes raw news and full private transcripts
